name: v2.6.0
body:
## [2.6.0] - 2026-10-10

### Added

- Luau: Added support for `if local` / `if const` condition bindings in both `if` statements and `if` expressions (e.g. `if local x = getValue() then ... end`)
- Added `Input` mode for `collapse_simple_statement`, preserving whether simple statements are single-line or multi-line in the input while still formatting their contents ([#1112](https://github.com/JohnnyMorganz/StyLua/pull/1112))

### Fixed

- Fixed range formatting indenting statements one level too shallow when nested inside a function expression within a table constructor ([#1145](https://github.com/JohnnyMorganz/StyLua/issues/1145))
- Fixed `-- stylua: ignore start`/`end` ranges inside multiline tables reformatting the ignored fields ([#1134](https://github.com/JohnnyMorganz/StyLua/issues/1134))
- When using range formatting, semicolons outside of the provided range are no longer incorrectly formatted ([#1147](https://github.com/JohnnyMorganz/StyLua/issues/1147))
- Luau: Fixed sort requires not recognizing imports declared with `const`, e.g. `const Foo = require(path)`
- Luau: Fixed the `read`/`write` access modifier merging into the element type in array type shorthand, changing the meaning of the code (`{ read Foo }` was formatted as `{ readFoo }`) ([#1126](https://github.com/JohnnyMorganz/StyLua/issues/1126))
- Fixed single-line comments in CRLF files gaining an extra carriage return (`\r\r\n`) on every format when `line_endings = "Windows"`, and keeping their original `\r\n` when formatting to Unix line endings ([#1167](https://github.com/JohnnyMorganz/StyLua/pull/1167))

---

## External Contributions
* Mention conform.nvim as a Neovim formatter plugin that supports stylua by @alerque in https://github.com/JohnnyMorganz/StyLua/pull/1124
* Clarify the syntax for command-line formatting configuration by @kormide in https://github.com/JohnnyMorganz/StyLua/pull/1132
* Fix sort_requires not recognizing `const` imports in luau by @ddashdev in https://github.com/JohnnyMorganz/StyLua/pull/1123
* Fix Luau array access modifier formatting by @Companion in https://github.com/JohnnyMorganz/StyLua/pull/1148
* Keep out-of-range semicolons when formatting a range by @GhostCoder6969 in https://github.com/JohnnyMorganz/StyLua/pull/1158
* support if-local and if-const by @annieetang in https://github.com/JohnnyMorganz/StyLua/pull/1160
* Add Input mode for collapse_simple_statement by @ddashdev in https://github.com/JohnnyMorganz/StyLua/pull/1112

* @GhostCoder6969 made their first contribution in https://github.com/JohnnyMorganz/StyLua/pull/1158
